column12: Judgement: half of the measured analogue. EV+P is the closest measured launch, a Pfizer vedotin ADC added to pembrolizumab in first line, but it replaced platinum chemotherapy after doubling overall survival; sigvotatug vedotin would be added to an already effective pembrolizumab monotherapy, its monotherapy Phase 3 missed overall survival, and first-line PD-L1-high NSCLC is contested by chemo-immunotherapy, PD-1xVEGF bispecifics and other ADC combinations. No independent forecast covers this indication alone: GlobalData's projection of over $1bn in the seven major markets by 2032 (May 2025) predates the second-line failure, which Pfizer impaired by $3.8bn in Q2 2026, and by 2032 would rest mostly on that failed line. The case for higher: EV+P reached 62% by its second year. The case for lower: the PF-08046054 seed takes 0.25 against docetaxel in second line
